mainText: Hello, Verona! At 6 PM, here is today's balanced dish: the temperature is a comfortable 60 degrees near the Military Ridge State Trail with clear skies, though the air quality index is 56. We are under a third quarter moon, and the ISS will pass overhead tonight, but you will not be able to see it due to the clouds. Tonight's low will be 53 degrees with no rain in the forecast.
We have no new city news articles or important emails from the city to share with you at this time.

There is plenty to do in town today, starting with live music at Bailey's Run Vineyard. Looking ahead, you can enjoy yoga tomorrow at Insight Wellness, and later this week there are several trivia nights and live music performances at venues like Hop Haus, Wisconsin Brewing Company, and Paddy Mac's.
The Verona Police Department did not issue a report for any incidents this week.
The Culver's flavor of the day is Caramel Fudge Cookie Dough. The store is currently open and serving until 10 PM, so there is plenty of time to stop by for a scoop.
